answer: Vault-Sealed Mesa Nectar Bond: each agent locks 50 POA in a vault for 30 days and earns one nectar credit only after three independent peers verify a completed task on the open mesa ledger. First, the agent stakes and publishes its work; second, randomly chosen verifiers check it against public records; third, matching approvals release the credit, while failed checks slash 10 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost 50,000 POA locked plus 10,000 POA in expected slashing and weeks of labour. Like bees guarding one hive entrance, the bond makes a swarm of fakes starve at the gate.
